_comment: Server-side only. Deliberately not under client/config/, which is served to the browser — a player who can read the loot table has been spoiled. Edit freely: server/services/loot.js validates shape at load and every entry is covered by loot.test.js.

affixes.label: of Embers
affixes.effect: On a hit, this weapon deals an extra 1d6 fire damage.

affixes.label: of the Long Winter
affixes.effect: On a hit, this weapon deals an extra 1d6 cold damage and the target's speed is halved until the end of its next turn.

affixes.label: of Hunger
affixes.effect: When this weapon reduces a creature to 0 hit points, the wielder regains 1d6 hit points.

affixes.label: of the Unerring Hand
affixes.effect: Once per encounter, the wielder may reroll a missed attack with this weapon.

affixes.label: Whisperfang
affixes.effect: This weapon makes no sound when drawn or when it strikes. Attacks made with it from hiding do not reveal the wielder's position.

affixes.label: Ruinbrand
affixes.effect: This weapon ignores non-magical armour: attacks with it are resolved against AC 10 + the target's Dexterity modifier.

affixes.label: Kingsbane
affixes.effect: Against a creature that has a name and a title, this weapon scores a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20 and deals an extra 2d10 damage.

affixes.label: of Warding
affixes.effect: Faint wards are worked into every plate, and blows that should have landed turn aside. Its stated AC already includes them.

affixes.label: of Whisperstep
affixes.effect: The wearer has advantage on Stealth checks, and this armour imposes no stealth penalty.

affixes.label: of the Bulwark
affixes.effect: Once per encounter, the wearer may reduce the damage of one hit by 2d6.

affixes.label: Emberhide
affixes.effect: The wearer has resistance to fire damage and cannot gain the burning condition.

affixes.label: of the Unbowed
affixes.effect: The wearer has advantage on saving throws against being frightened, charmed or paralyzed.

affixes.label: Lastlight
affixes.effect: The first time the wearer would drop to 0 hit points in an encounter, they drop to 1 instead and this armour goes dark until the next long rest.

affixes.label: of the Watchful Eye
affixes.effect: The wearer has advantage on Perception checks.

affixes.label: of the Silver Tongue
affixes.effect: The wearer has advantage on Persuasion checks made with someone who does not already hate them.

affixes.label: of the Wayfinder
affixes.effect: The wearer always knows which way is north and how long they have been underground.

affixes.label: of the Second Wind
affixes.effect: Once per long rest, the wearer may regain 2d6 hit points as a bonus action.

affixes.label: of the Veil
affixes.effect: Once per long rest, the wearer may turn invisible until they attack or for one minute, whichever comes first.

affixes.label: of Nine Lives
affixes.effect: The wearer may reroll any one failed saving throw per long rest. One of the nine notches on its band closes each time.

affixes.label: of the Worldwalker
affixes.effect: Once per long rest, the wearer may step through a doorway they have previously walked through and arrive at it, wherever it now stands.
